2609.08663.title: MoEMB: Scaling Universal Multimodal Embeddings with Efficient Mixture-of-Experts Models
2609.08663.paper_summary: Universal multimodal embedding (UME) increasingly demands encoder's capacity for handling a broad range of tasks and modalities with increased complexity. Prior scaling methods either increase the representation size, retrieval effort, or scales the encoder into a heavy multimodal LLM. Recent works, such as Think-Then-Embed (TTE), explore scaling via reasoning tokens. However, embedding models are hard to scale up: increasing parameters directly tradeoffs for the large training batch size that contrastive learning needs, and retrieval has to be served under tight latency. Moreover, UME tasks are diverse in complexity, where scaling up embedders can bring significant redundant computation. In this work, we propose MOEMB, which instead scales UME along the expert axis through mixture-of-experts (MoE), growing encoder capacity while preserving single-vector, non-autoregressive encoding. Through a systematic study of the design space and training recipes for MoE-based UME, MoEMB sets a new state of the art on both MMEB-V2 and MRMR among models trained on public MMEB-family data: with only 3B active parameters, MoEMB surpasses TTE-based methods with >4x active parameters, using significantly less computes. To further improve the scalability and efficiency, we conduct the first comprehensive study of adaptive computation for MoE-based embedding, spanning diverse strategies across training-based and inference-only methods. Together, these results support expert scaling as an effective and efficient direction for UME, with adaptive computation further improving efficiency for MLLM-based embedding models towards large-scale retrieval and recommendation systems.
2609.08663.paper_summary_zh: 普遍多模態嵌入（UME）越來越需要編碼器具備處理廣泛任務和模態的能力，且這些任務和模態的複雜性不斷增加。先前的擴展方法要麼增加表示大小，要麼增加檢索工作量，或者將編碼器擴展為重型多模態大型語言模型（LLM）。最近的研究，如Think-Then-Embed（TTE），探討了通過推理標記進行擴展的可能性。然而，嵌入模型難以擴展：增加參數會直接與對比學習所需的大訓練批次大小形成權衡，且檢索必須在嚴格的延遲下進行。此外，UME任務在複雜性上各不相同，擴展嵌入器可能帶來顯著的冗餘計算。在本研究中，我們提出了MOEMB，它通過專家混合（MoE）沿著專家軸擴展UME，增強編碼器的能力，同時保持單向量、非自回歸編碼。通過對基於MoE的UME設計空間和訓練配方的系統研究，MOEMB在公共MMEB家族數據上訓練的模型中，在MMEB-V2和MRMR上設立了新的最先進水平：僅使用30億個活躍參數，MOEMB超越了基於TTE的方法，活躍參數超過4倍，且計算量顯著減少。為了進一步提高可擴展性和效率，我們進行了首個針對基於MoE的嵌入的自適應計算的綜合研究，涵蓋了基於訓練和僅基於推理的方法的多種策略。這些結果共同支持專家擴展作為UME的一個有效且高效的方向，自適應計算進一步提高了基於大型語言模型（MLLM）的嵌入模型在大規模檢索和推薦系統中的效率。
